cases.description: 10 total direct dependencies, 4 of them (pkg-g through pkg-j) range-unpinned — a 40% unpinned surface area. This aggregate figure is the checklist's surface-area item, distinct from the four individual unpinned-range flags: even though each flag alone is low severity, the aggregate 40% figure is what a reviewer should actually weigh when deciding whether to prioritize a pinning pass across this manifest.
cases.grounding: surface_area.py computes unpinned_count=4, total_dependencies=10, unpinned_percentage=40.0 from the same records the scanner flagged individually.
